[[The Brainfreezer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Dazehl Brainfreezer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Varajar Fells]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Frost Artifact]] [[dye]]d purple.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Frost Artifact]] from collectors [[Arliss Vaughn]], [[Hagnon Warblade]], or [[Pietro]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]]
OR
*[[Frost Artifact]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
AND
*Purple [[dye]]


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
The [[Water Magic]] version of [[Droknar's Focus]] has stats identical to this item.
